$comment: Agent registry manifest. Flip a sub-agent from in-process to a remote HTTP service by setting transport=http and base_url. See todo/COORDINATOR_PLAN.md sec 4.

agents.name: text_to_bpmn
agents.description: Guideline/NL text -> validated BPMN 2.0 (+DMN). Wraps the staged text_to_bpmn pipeline.

agents.name: regulatory_docs
agents.description: Upload/find regulatory documents and vectorize a selected one into Qdrant (profiles in config/vectorization.json).

agents.name: petri_net_generator
agents.description: BPMN 2.0 XML / text_to_bpmn IR / NL text -> ordinary workflow Petri net (PNML) with structural + soundness validation.

agents.name: text_to_eflint
agents.description: Regulatory text -> executable eFLINT specification (facts, duties, acts, scenarios), LLM-drafted then parsed, type-checked, grounded and scenario-tested with a repair loop.

agents.name: eflint_verifier
agents.description: Verify a Petri-net process against an eFLINT specification (qualification rules + bounded model/compliance checking). In-process wrapper around the external eflint-model-checking webservice (EFLINT_VERIFIER_URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8100).
